embedded_models.purpose: Local automated speech recognition (ASR), multi-language voiceover transcription, sentence/word segmentation, and millisecond-accurate word-level timestamp extraction.
embedded_models.model_architecture: Encoder-Decoder Transformer (Whisper architecture optimized via CTranslate2 quantization)

priority_order: 5. CPU fallback (int8 quantization with cpu_threads = min(8, os.cpu_count() or 4))

model_lifecycle.loading_strategy: Lazy loaded singleton on first invocation of analyze_voiceover
model_lifecycle.persistence: Resident in memory for duration of MCP server process; reused across multiple tool calls if model_size matches

caching_mechanisms.inference_output_cache: .{audio_stem}_{sha256[:8]}.analysis.json saved in the same directory as source audio file

inputs.audio_path: str (path to wav/mp3/m4a audio file, decoded to 16 kHz mono float32 numpy array)
inputs.language: str | None (optional ISO 639-1 language code, e.g. 'ar', 'en')
inputs.model_size: str | None (optional model size name, defaults to 'base')

embedded_models.failure_behavior: Catches exceptions gracefully via _fallback_analysis; extracts audio duration using ffprobe subprocess and returns structured fallback payload with single speech segment '[Audio Voiceover Track]' without crashing the MCP server.

resource_requirements.disk: ~150 MB (base model weights) in HuggingFace cache

embedded_models.verification_evidence: Executed live transcription on assets/incoming/tests/human_vo_01.wav with model_size='tiny' via UV runtime in scratch/run_actual_mcp_verification.py. Successfully returned text, duration (2.85s), and word timestamps.

embedded_models.purpose: Voice activity detection (VAD); calculates speech probabilities across audio frames to demarcate active speech boundaries and compute silence intervals for accurate video timeline pacing.

model_lifecycle.loading_strategy: Lazy loaded singleton on first invocation via WhisperModelManager.get_vad_model()
model_lifecycle.persistence: Resident in memory for process lifetime

caching_mechanisms.model_file_cache: Cached inside faster_whisper/assets/silero_vad.onnx in virtualenv site-packages

outputs.speech_timestamps: list[dict] with 'start' and 'end' frame/sample timestamps converted to seconds

embedded_models.failure_behavior: If VAD calculation fails, logs warning and falls back to whole-audio single speech interval: [{'start': 0.0, 'end': audio_duration}].
embedded_models.verification_evidence: Executed live during analyze_voiceover test in scratch/run_actual_mcp_verification.py. Accurately extracted speech periods and silence intervals.

evaluated_non_ml_subsystems.rationale: Uses classical Lanczos sinc-based digital interpolation resampling algorithm. No neural network or learned weights.
Uses classical pixel color subtraction and thresholding to find non-background bounding boxes. No neural network.
Uses native FFmpeg luminance threshold calculation (pic_th, pix_th). No neural network.
External cloud API client, not a local embedded MCP model.
